_comment: Read/write split for contributor agents (fixes #2356; addresses #2393 item 6).
READ-ONLY GitHub lookups are ALLOWED so an agent can check whether a PR
already exists for its assigned issue BEFORE starting work — this is what
prevents duplicate PRs. The wrapper (bin/gh-wrapper.sh) is the authoritative
gate: it permits `gh pr list`/`gh issue list`/`gh search`/read-only view/diff
commands and GET-only `gh api repos/*/{issues,pulls}` reads, while still
WRITE/DESTRUCTIVE operations below stay denied for contributor agents.
gh pr create is EXEMPT here (contributors fork+PR under their own identity).

rules.reason: Repo settings changes disabled for contributors
